name: props_solids_temperature
source:
{ SolidProperties spot-checks with the OPTIONAL temperature argument, which the
  existing probe never exercises. Only k_ and c_ take the linear slope about 300 K,
  only the nine sloped metals have one, and rho_/E_/nu_ ignore T entirely. Absurd
  temperatures are extrapolated without a guard -- k_(Copper, T=10000) is negative in
  the reference and must stay negative. }
k_al_300   = k_(Aluminum, T=300)
k_al_400   = k_(Aluminum, T=400)
k_al_250   = k_(Aluminum, T=250)
k_al_0     = k_(Aluminum, T=0)
k_al_10000 = k_(Aluminum, T=10000)
c_al_400   = c_(Aluminum, T=400)
c_al_0     = c_(Aluminum, T=0)
rho_al_400 = rho_(Aluminum, T=400)
e_al_400   = E_(Aluminum, T=400)
nu_al_400  = nu_(Aluminum, T=400)

k_cu_400   = k_(Copper, T=400)
k_cu_10000 = k_(Copper, T=10000)
c_cu_400   = c_(Copper, T=400)
k_steel_600 = k_(Steel, T=600)
c_steel_600 = c_(Steel, T=600)
k_cs_600   = k_(CarbonSteel, T=600)
k_fe_600   = k_(Iron, T=600)
c_fe_600   = c_(Iron, T=600)
k_ni_600   = k_(Nickel, T=600)
c_ni_600   = c_(Nickel, T=600)
k_ti_600   = k_(Titanium, T=600)
c_ti_600   = c_(Titanium, T=600)
k_w_600    = k_(Tungsten, T=600)
c_w_600    = c_(Tungsten, T=600)

{ materials with NO slope: the temperature argument must be ignored exactly }
k_ss_600   = k_(StainlessSteel, T=600)
k_ss_300   = k_(StainlessSteel, T=300)
k_brass_900 = k_(Brass, T=900)
k_gold_900 = k_(Gold, T=900)
k_conc_900 = k_(Concrete, T=900)
k_glass_900 = k_(Glass, T=900)
k_brick_900 = k_(Brick, T=900)
k_wood_900 = k_(Wood, T=900)
k_ice_900  = k_(Ice, T=900)
c_ice_900  = c_(Ice, T=900)
k_zn_900   = k_(Zinc, T=900)
k_mg_900   = k_(Magnesium, T=900)
k_pb_900   = k_(Lead, T=900)
k_ag_900   = k_(Silver, T=900)
k_bronze_900 = k_(Bronze, T=900)
k_oak_900  = k_(Oak, T=900)
